relations.label: rin chen tshul khrims (3) (7907) requests bsod nams rin chen (3) (7418)

comments:
Son of a siddha named La stod dkar po. Said to have "taken the see" (it is not specified of which institution) after Zhang e pa (ID:6660) ([3HXACZSD]: 214, based on the Red Annals).

Based on the Red Annals, this is the same person as the "monk bSod nams rin chen" who authored the "las kyi me long" (ID:5239) ([3HXACZSD]: 214) and hence also the author of the topical outline (ID:5247) and the auto-commentary on the first (ID:7972) .
The editors of [KUYBGM7V] suggest as author of the two works the 13th-century gSang phu ba bSod nams rin chen mchog.
